keyPoints.en: Carbohydrate gives energy; protein builds; fat stores energy.
keyPoints.bm: Karbohidrat memberi tenaga; protein membina; lemak menyimpan tenaga.

keyPoints.en: Vitamins and minerals keep the body healthy.

points.en: Reducing sugar: Benedict's turns brick-red when heated.
points.bm: Gula penurun: Benedict menjadi merah bata apabila dipanaskan.

points.en: Protein: Millon's gives a red precipitate.
Fat: alcohol-emulsion test gives a cloudy layer.
points.bm: Lemak: ujian emulsi alkohol memberi lapisan keruh.

tip.en: Learn each food test with its positive colour.
tip.bm: Hafal setiap ujian makanan dengan warna positifnya.

keyPoints.en: Energy needs depend on age, sex, activity and health.
keyPoints.bm: Keperluan tenaga bergantung pada umur, jantina, aktiviti dan kesihatan.

keyPoints.en: Too little or too much causes disease.
keyPoints.bm: Terlalu sedikit atau banyak menyebabkan penyakit.

keyPoints.en: Use the Malaysian Food Pyramid as a guide.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan Piramid Makanan Malaysia sebagai panduan.

question.en: Why do pregnant mothers need more food?
question.bm: Mengapa ibu hamil memerlukan lebih makanan?

tip.en: Energy value of food is measured in joules.
tip.bm: Nilai tenaga makanan diukur dalam joule.

keyPoints.en: Bile emulsifies fat; it is not an enzyme.
keyPoints.bm: Hempedu mengemulsi lemak; ia bukan enzim.

tip.en: Learn enzyme, food, product and location together.
tip.bm: Hafal enzim, makanan, hasil dan lokasi bersama.

keyPoints.en: Villi absorb glucose, amino acids, fatty acids and glycerol.
keyPoints.bm: Vilus menyerap glukosa, asid amino, asid lemak dan gliserol.

keyPoints.en: Blood carries nutrients to the liver, then the body.
keyPoints.bm: Darah membawa nutrien ke hati, kemudian ke seluruh badan.

keyPoints.en: Undigested food leaves through the anus as faeces.
keyPoints.bm: Makanan tidak tercerna keluar melalui dubur sebagai tinja.

answer.bm: Dinding setebal satu sel; banyak kapilari.

tip.en: Defecation is not excretion: faeces were never in the cells.
tip.bm: Penyahtinjaan bukan perkumuhan: tinja tidak pernah berada dalam sel.
